name: TunnelSats
description: TunnelSats provides dedicated WireGuard VPN tunnels with static port forwarding for Lightning Network nodes, allowing your myNode LND node to route hybrid Clearnet + Tor traffic safely without exposing your residential IP address.

Features in-app server discovery, BOLT11 Lightning checkout, automatic subscription claiming and renewal, $1 bandwidth top-ups, NIP-47 NWC auto-renewal, local X25519 key custody, and a fail-closed cgroup v2 + nftables managed dataplane.

app_page_content.heading: Getting Started
content: Click Open App on the left to launch the TunnelSats dashboard.
Select a VPN server region and subscription plan (1, 3, 6, or 12 months), or import an existing TunnelSats WireGuard configuration.

Pay the BOLT11 Lightning invoice with any Lightning wallet. TunnelSats generates your WireGuard X25519 private key locally on your myNode device and provisions your dedicated forwarded port automatically.

In Automated Mode (default), TunnelSats configures the fail-closed managed dataplane (tunnelsats.slice + nftables kill switch) and updates /mnt/hdd/mynode/settings/lnd_extra_config.conf for hybrid Clearnet + Tor routing.
In Manual / CLI Mode (SECURE_MODE=true), the dashboard stages your configuration at /mnt/hdd/mynode/tunnelsats/tunnelsatsv2.conf and displays exact SSH commands for manual operator execution.
